books_with_authors.description: Every book, with the author's name joined in.
books_with_authors.sql: select books.title as title, authors.name as author, books.year as year, books.genre as genre from books join authors on authors.id = books.author_id order by books.year
books_with_authors.title: Books with their authors

authors.description: Authors of the books in the catalogue.

books.description: Books in the catalogue. author_id points at the authors table.
